nodes.gloss: This means coming from the middle of society: raised on a salary and a mortgage, college expected, a neutral accent, comfortable but careful with money, and used to passing the orders along.

nodes.label: mischievous
nodes.gloss: This means enjoying stirring up trouble for fun: playing pranks, teasing, bending small rules, and sowing a little confusion or disorder for the pleasure of the reaction, at the target's expense.

nodes.label: mobility impaired
nodes.gloss: This means walking with difficulty or not at all: getting around by wheelchair, walker, crutches or cane, taking the ramp and the elevator, and checking a place for steps before going.

nodes.label: modest
nodes.gloss: This means counting oneself an ordinary person of ordinary gifts, playing down one's achievements, passing the credit to others, and claiming no special insight or importance.

nodes.label: monogamous
nodes.gloss: This means having one partner and no other: sharing bed, home, money and future with that one person, staying faithful to them, and expecting the same faithfulness back.

nodes.label: muscular
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a lot of muscle, whether from the gym, years of lifting and hauling, or the build one was born with: broad shoulders, sleeves tight on the arms, and strength to spare.

nodes.label: Muslim
nodes.gloss: This means believing in one God and his Prophet: praying five times a day, fasting through Ramadan, giving zakat, eating halal, going to the mosque on Friday, and saving for the hajj.

nodes.label: naive
nodes.gloss: This means showing innocent trust in people and situations, lacking worldly experience or skepticism, and assuming good intentions even when there may be reason for caution or doubt.

nodes.label: nearsighted
nodes.gloss: This means seeing clearly only up close: glasses or contacts from first thing in the morning, faces across the street a blur without them, and a stronger prescription every few years.

nodes.label: neuter
nodes.gloss: This means showing no gender in dress, voice or bearing: plain clothes cut for no gender in particular, a manner that gives no clue, and nothing manly or womanly to point to.

nodes.label: nomadic
nodes.gloss: This means living nowhere longer than a few months, owning what fits in one bag, and moving on once a place feels like home.

nodes.label: nonbinary
nodes.gloss: This means being neither a man nor a woman: going by they or another chosen pronoun, correcting a 'sir' or 'ma'am', and checking the third box where a form has one.

nodes.label: northern hemisphere
nodes.gloss: This means being from the Northern Hemisphere: raised in a country north of the equator, where summer comes in June and the Pole Star shows in the night sky.

nodes.label: oblivious
nodes.gloss: This means not noticing the new haircut, the moved chair, the faint smell of smoke, every small change in one's surroundings, until someone points it out.

nodes.label: observant
nodes.gloss: This means spotting the new haircut, the moved chair, the faint smell of smoke, every small change in one's surroundings, before anyone points it out.

nodes.label: only child
nodes.gloss: This means growing up the one child in a quiet house, with no brothers or sisters, and keeping the parents' attention, the bedroom and the toys to oneself.

nodes.label: organized
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a system for one's things and one's time: everything filed and labeled, a calendar kept, nothing mislaid, and each day planned before it starts.

nodes.label: pacifist
nodes.gloss: This means consistently opposing violence, warfare, and the use of force as means of resolving conflicts or disputes, advocating instead for peaceful, non-violent alternatives in all circumstances.

nodes.label: pansexual
nodes.gloss: This means being attracted, sexually and romantically, to people whatever their gender: falling for the person and not the category, and dating and building a life with men, women or nonbinary people.

nodes.label: parent
nodes.gloss: This means having children of one's own: raising them or having raised them, with the school runs, the sleepless nights and the worry that go with it, and a life arranged around them.

nodes.label: persevering
nodes.gloss: This means keeping at a hard goal through failure, boredom and rejection, starting again the morning after each setback, and stopping only when it is done.

nodes.label: physical touch
nodes.gloss: This means feeling loved through touch and being very touchy oneself: hugs, pats on the back and holding hands carry care and excitement, physical presence is crucial, and neglect is unforgivable.

nodes.label: picky-eater
nodes.gloss: This means sticking to the few foods one trusts, sending back anything with a strange sauce or texture, and refusing even to taste the unfamiliar.

nodes.label: plain-looking
nodes.gloss: This means having a face and figure nobody looks at twice: unremarkable features, no compliments on one's looks, photographs that come out ordinary, and a face nobody remembers after one meeting.

nodes.label: plain-spoken
nodes.gloss: This means communicating in simple, direct, unadorned language without rhetorical flourishes, elaborate vocabulary, or stylistic embellishment, prioritizing straightforward clarity over elegance or persuasiveness.

nodes.label: polite
nodes.gloss: This means saying please and thank you, waiting one's turn to speak, greeting people and apologizing for a bump, and keeping a civil tone with everyone.

nodes.label: polyamorous
nodes.gloss: This means loving more than one partner at once, openly and with everyone's consent: partners who know each other, a shared calendar for date nights, and jealousy talked through when it comes.

nodes.label: poor
nodes.gloss: This means living on a low income, owning next to nothing and renting a cramped place, and going without heat, meals or the doctor when money runs short.

nodes.label: popular
nodes.gloss: This means being liked by nearly everyone in the class or the office, picked first, invited everywhere, and missed by all when away.

nodes.label: pretentious
nodes.gloss: This means putting on airs, reaching for the big word, the name and the reference to seem cultured or important, and looking down on plain talk and plain tastes.

nodes.label: punishment-fearing
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding misdeeds because one fears being punished for them, whether by the courts, the gods, hellfire, karma, vengeful spirits or a lynch mob: confessing only to lighten a punishment already coming.

nodes.label: quick-witted
nodes.gloss: This means catching the point before anyone else, working out a puzzle or an answer on the spot, and having the right reply ready at once.

nodes.label: read-write (VARK)
nodes.gloss: This means taking in and giving out information as written words: reading and writing in every form, especially manuals, reports and essays, and often hooked on lists, diaries, dictionaries and quotations.

nodes.label: realistic (Holland)
nodes.gloss: This means being drawn to work done with the hands: designing, building and repairing equipment, materials and structures, operating machines, working outdoors with plants and animals, and physical or manual labor.

nodes.label: red-headed
nodes.gloss: This means having copper to auburn hair: freckles across the nose and arms, skin that burns in minutes and never tans, and hair that fades pale, not gray, with the years.

nodes.label: reserved
nodes.gloss: This means keeping feelings out of sight, putting none of one's own joys, worries, or soft spots into words, and keeping a polite distance from everyone.

nodes.label: resilient
nodes.gloss: This means the ability to recover quickly from difficulties, adapt to challenging situations, maintain emotional stability during adversity, and demonstrate persistence in the face of setbacks.

nodes.label: resourceful
nodes.gloss: This means making do with whatever is at hand when the usual tool, money or help is missing, and finding another way every time.

nodes.label: respectful
nodes.gloss: This means treating other people as capable equals, crediting them with understanding, taking their questions seriously, and never talking down to anyone, whatever they happen to know.

nodes.label: restless
nodes.gloss: This means being unable to settle, fidgeting through any quiet moment, mind and hands always reaching for the next thing, and finding stillness uncomfortable even when nothing is wrong.

nodes.label: rigid
nodes.gloss: This means insisting on the one right way and proper conditions, never bending the plan when circumstances change, and leaving the job undone rather than done differently.

nodes.label: rooted
nodes.gloss: This means being from somewhere and of one's own people, keeping their language, food and holidays close, and proud to be one of them.

nodes.label: rootless
nodes.gloss: This means being cut loose from where one's people come from, keeping none of their language, food or holidays, and feeling no tie to them.

nodes.label: rude
nodes.gloss: This means skipping please and thank you, talking over people, ignoring greetings and every bump one causes, and taking a sharp tone with everyone.

nodes.label: secular-rational (Inglehart-Welzel)
nodes.gloss: This means setting less store by religion, conventional family values and authority than others do, and seeing divorce, abortion, euthanasia and suicide as fairly acceptable.

nodes.label: sedentary
nodes.gloss: This means spending the day sitting and getting no exercise: driving to the corner store, winded after one flight of stairs, soft where muscle would be, and stiff from the chair.

nodes.label: self-aggrandizing
nodes.gloss: This means making oneself the hero of every story one tells, coming off the smartest person in it, and talking up one's own wins and looks.

nodes.label: self-conscious
nodes.gloss: This means being painfully aware of being looked at, going quiet and red when strangers glance one's way, stumbling over words when all eyes turn, and dreading being asked to speak up.

nodes.label: self-deprecating
nodes.gloss: This means making oneself the joke of every story one tells, coming off the biggest fool in it, and laughing first at one's own mistakes and looks.

nodes.label: self-effacing
nodes.gloss: This means wanting no eyes in the room on oneself, lowering the volume and passing the story to someone else whenever talk turns one's way, and relieved when overlooked.

nodes.label: serene
nodes.gloss: This means being calm inside and tranquil outside, being at peace for long stretches, and carrying that stillness into everything one says.

nodes.label: settled
nodes.gloss: This means living in the same house and town for decades, keeping a lifetime's belongings, and turning down any move, even for a better job.

nodes.label: shabby-genteel
nodes.gloss: This means being born into a family whose money is long gone, with the manners, the accent and the books still handed down, and the coat worn thin, the bills unpaid.

nodes.label: shame-prone
nodes.gloss: This means avoiding misdeeds because others would see and condemn them: stung by ridicule or rejection, even imagined, untroubled by a fault that never gets out, and finding no relief in confessing.

nodes.label: short
nodes.gloss: This means standing a head below most people: a step stool for the top shelf, hems taken up on every pair of pants, and seeing only backs in a crowd.

nodes.label: sickly
nodes.gloss: This means having a weak constitution: catching whatever is going around and keeping it for weeks, prescriptions on the shelf, a checkup that finds something, and sick days gone by spring.

nodes.label: single
nodes.gloss: This means having no husband or wife, settling one's home, money and plans without a spouse, and checking 'single' on every form.

nodes.label: sleep-deprived
nodes.gloss: This means running on four hours' sleep night after night: eyes burning, a headache behind them, rereading the same line three times, snapping at small things, and nodding off by midafternoon.

nodes.label: slight
nodes.gloss: This means carrying little muscle on a light frame, whatever one weighs: narrow shoulders and thin wrists, a suitcase that takes both hands, and jar lids that will not budge.

nodes.label: sloppy
nodes.gloss: This means doing the work fast and rough, skipping the checking, leaving loose ends, mislabeled figures and small mistakes, and calling it done.

nodes.label: slovenly
nodes.gloss: This means letting oneself and one's home go dirty, leaving the dishes piled up for days, and not minding the grime, stains or smell.

nodes.label: slow-witted
nodes.gloss: This means catching the point long after everyone else, needing a puzzle or an answer explained twice, and finding the right reply only hours later.

nodes.label: Slytherin
nodes.gloss: This means being ambitious, shrewd, cunning and proud, always one step ahead and using any means to achieve one's ends, minding one's reputation, and never letting anyone see one's soft side.

nodes.label: smoker
nodes.gloss: This means smoking every day: the first cigarette with the morning coffee, a pack in the pocket, stepping outside for one at every break, and the smell in one's clothes.

nodes.label: socially-obtuse
nodes.gloss: This means missing the glance at the clock, the tight smile and the hint in a polite remark, and not sensing the room's mood until told.

nodes.label: socially-perceptive
nodes.gloss: This means catching the glance at the clock, the tight smile and the hint in a polite remark, and sensing the room's mood before anyone says it.

nodes.label: solemn
nodes.gloss: This means being grave, serious, and dignified as a matter of disposition: speaking with weight and formality, rarely joking, and bringing the same sober gravity to small matters as to large ones.

nodes.label: southern hemisphere
nodes.gloss: This means being from the Southern Hemisphere: raised in a country south of the equator, where summer comes in December and the Southern Cross shows in the night sky.

nodes.label: spiritual
nodes.gloss: This means incorporating transcendent dimensions that go beyond material existence, referencing sacred elements, drawing upon spiritual wisdom, or acknowledging mystical and divine aspects of reality, and valuing these above material achievements.

nodes.label: squeamish
nodes.gloss: This means turning queasy at blood, pus, vomit, rotting food or a depraved act, looking away, gagging, and refusing to touch it or hear more.

nodes.label: staid
nodes.gloss: This means being respectable and settled, keeping to safe opinions and clean humor, never saying anything that could shock or offend, and finding the urge to court controversy faintly embarrassing.

nodes.label: steadiness (DISC)
nodes.gloss: This means being moderate-paced and accepting: gentle, accommodating and patient with others' mistakes, calm and careful in how one works, focused on people over logic, and empathizing and agreeable rather than challenging.

nodes.label: steady
nodes.gloss: This means holding the same tone, approach and view through a whole conversation. Any change of course is announced and explained, never a swerve.

nodes.label: stigmatized
nodes.gloss: This means carrying a mark people hold against one, a record, an illness, a past: seeing them go quiet on learning it, and weighing in every new room whether to tell.

nodes.label: straight
nodes.gloss: This means being straight in sexual orientation: attracted, sexually and romantically, to people of the opposite sex, and falling for, dating and building a life with them.

nodes.label: stressed
nodes.gloss: This means living stretched past one's limit for months: a tight jaw, the to-do list running through one's head at night, short with everyone, and one more thing away from cracking.

nodes.label: strong-stomached
nodes.gloss: This means staying calm at blood, pus, vomit, rotting food or a depraved act, looking straight at it, and touching it or hearing more without a flinch.

nodes.label: tactful
nodes.gloss: This means carefully considering the emotional impact of one's words on others and choosing diplomatic, sensitive language that avoids causing hurt feelings while still being helpful and honest.

nodes.label: tall
nodes.gloss: This means standing a head above most people: ducking through old doorways, knees against the seat in front, being asked to reach the top shelf, and sleeves that never reach the wrist.

nodes.label: Taurus
nodes.gloss: This means being solid and hard to shift: steady in one's habits, dependable, fond of comfort and bodily pleasures of every kind, holding on to what one has, and plain stubborn.

nodes.label: teetotaler
nodes.gloss: This means drinking no alcohol at all, not even a toast at a wedding, and ordering soda when the round comes.

nodes.label: temperamental
nodes.gloss: This means showing variable emotional responses that shift dramatically based on context, expressing frustration, excitement, or disappointment with noticeable intensity and unpredictable emotional fluctuations.

nodes.label: theatrical
nodes.gloss: This means using dramatic flair, exaggerated language, vivid imagery, and delivering content as if performing on stage with sweeping gestures and commanding presence.

nodes.label: thick-skinned
nodes.gloss: This means being unbothered by any jab, joke or criticism, taking no offense at even a harsh remark, and forgetting it within the minute.

nodes.label: thin
nodes.gloss: This means carrying little body fat: shopping the smaller sizes, belts cinched to the last hole, room to spare in any seat, and feeling the cold before anyone else.

nodes.label: thin-skinned
nodes.gloss: This means being stung by every jab, joke or criticism, taking offense at the slightest remark, and brooding over it or snapping back for days.

nodes.label: tight (Gelfand)
nodes.gloss: This means holding many strong rules of conduct, expecting them to apply in nearly every situation, having little tolerance for anyone who steps outside them, and wanting structure and self-restraint.

nodes.label: tough (HEXACO)
nodes.gloss: This means pressing on where one could get hurt, staying unworried under pressure, seldom sharing one's troubles or leaning on anyone, and holding people at arm's length.

nodes.label: traditional
nodes.gloss: This means showing preference for established methods, conventional wisdom, proven approaches, and time-tested practices over new or experimental alternatives.

nodes.label: traditional (Inglehart-Welzel)
nodes.gloss: This means putting religion, conventional family values and deference to authority first, keeping parents and children close, rejecting divorce, abortion, euthanasia and suicide, and taking great pride in one's nation.

nodes.label: traumatized
nodes.gloss: This means still living inside what happened: jumping at a slammed door, the scene coming back uninvited by day and in dreams, avoiding whatever brings it back, and never feeling safe.

nodes.label: tunnel-visioned
nodes.gloss: This means locking onto one approach and staying on it, treating the first assumptions or initial indications as settled, repeating the same move after it fails, and never revisiting assumptions or asking whether the framing itself is wrong.

nodes.label: turbulent
nodes.gloss: This means being stormy inside and restless outside, swinging from one feeling to the next, never at peace or serene for long, and carrying the churn into everything one says.

nodes.label: unassuming
nodes.gloss: This means no flourish, no performance, no commanding the room, just the point made quietly in plain words by someone who would rather go unnoticed.

nodes.label: understated
nodes.gloss: This means deliberately minimizing the importance or significance of things and expressing ideas with restraint, using modest language rather than emphatic or dramatic expressions.

nodes.label: uneducated
nodes.gloss: This means having left school at sixteen without a diploma, with no lectures, exams or theses behind one, and working for a living ever since.

nodes.label: unfair
nodes.gloss: This means treating people by different rules: hearing only the side one likes, taking more than one's share, playing favorites, and using any edge, cheating included.

nodes.label: unfashionable
nodes.gloss: This means not knowing or caring what is in style, wearing the same clothes year after year, and blind to how dated one looks.

nodes.label: unflappable
nodes.gloss: This means staying composed whatever lands, taking the surprise, the setback and the provocation without losing the thread or the tone, and never visibly flustered.

nodes.label: unhappily-partnered
nodes.gloss: This means being sick of the partner one has, dreading going home to them, and sure one would not choose them again.

nodes.label: unhurried
nodes.gloss: This means being in no hurry about anything, treating nothing as pressing, letting things wait until convenient, and assuming that whatever it is will keep.

nodes.label: uninsured
nodes.gloss: This means having no health insurance: putting off the doctor until it cannot wait, paying cash at the urgent care, guessing at what a visit will cost, and hoping nothing serious happens.

nodes.label: unpopular
nodes.gloss: This means not being liked by anyone in the class or the office, picked last, left off every invitation, and missed by nobody when away.

nodes.label: unpretentious
nodes.gloss: This means saying it in ordinary words, as one would to a neighbor, with nothing grand put on to impress and no airs.

nodes.label: unschooled
nodes.gloss: This means being unbookish, knowing only what everyday life and common sense have taught, and putting it in plain words with no framework, reference or theory.

nodes.label: unselfconscious
nodes.gloss: This means never thinking about being looked at, chatting easily while strangers watch, carrying on as if nobody were there when all eyes turn, and speaking up without a second thought.

nodes.label: unsupported
nodes.gloss: This means having nobody in one's corner: no one to drive one home from the hospital, to lend the rent, to listen after a bad day, and carrying every load alone.

nodes.label: upper-class
nodes.gloss: This means coming from the top of society: raised with money, connections and a polished accent, at home in boardrooms and private clubs, and used to giving the orders.

nodes.label: uptight
nodes.gloss: This means being tense and buttoned-up, fussing that every small thing be done properly, unable to loosen up or let anything slide, and putting everyone on edge.

nodes.label: verbose
nodes.gloss: This means being long-winded in speech and writing: never using one word where ten will do, piling on elaboration, context, background and detail, and going well past what the matter calls for.

nodes.label: visceral
nodes.gloss: This means communicating from gut reactions and raw emotional responses rather than carefully measured or intellectualized language.

nodes.label: wealthy
nodes.gloss: This means living on a high income, owning a spacious home and investments besides, and paying for comfort, fine meals or the best doctor without a thought for cost.

nodes.label: well-behaved
nodes.gloss: This means no pranks, no teasing, no bending a rule for fun, keeping everything orderly, and frowning on anyone who stirs things up.

nodes.label: well-connected
nodes.gloss: This means having friends and contacts everywhere, always someone to call for a favor, a job lead or a word in the right ear.

nodes.label: western hemisphere
nodes.gloss: This means being from the Western Hemisphere: born and raised in the Americas, in a country such as Canada, Mexico, Brazil or Chile, and at home there.

nodes.label: whimsical
nodes.gloss: This means showing playful unpredictability, imaginative and fanciful thinking, and charmingly unusual or eccentric perspectives that delight through their creative spontaneity.

nodes.label: wide-eyed
nodes.gloss: This means seeing everything as if new, so the sunset, the big city and the fireworks take one's breath away.

nodes.label: working-class
nodes.gloss: This means coming from the working end of society: raised on wages and making do, with a plain accent, at home on the shop floor and in the pub, and used to taking the orders.

nodes.label: worldly
nodes.gloss: This means having seen enough of how people and deals really go to know the tricks, reading between the lines, and checking before believing.

nodes.label: young
nodes.gloss: This means being in one's teens or twenties, with most of life ahead, a quick body, friends one's own age, and today's world the only one known.

nodes.label: adorable
nodes.gloss: This means being charming and lovable in one's character and manner, drawing fondness from others through a warm, endearing disposition.

nodes.label: chattering
nodes.gloss: This means talking on and on in a quick, easy stream, filling every pause with small remarks, asides and passing thoughts, and rarely letting a silence settle.

nodes.label: crude
nodes.gloss: This means speaking and joking in a coarse, vulgar way, with rough language and crude humor, and showing no concern for polish or refinement in one's manner.

nodes.label: deft
nodes.gloss: This means handling tasks with a quick, skilled touch, working with one's hands in a way that is precise, nimble and easy to watch.

nodes.label: flattering
nodes.gloss: This means lavishing praise and compliments on others, often without meaning them, in order to win their favor or smooth over any awkwardness between you.

nodes.label: insulting
nodes.gloss: This means habitually mocking, demeaning and belittling the people one speaks to, using cutting remarks to make them feel small and foolish.

nodes.label: jumpy
nodes.gloss: This means being easily startled and keeping a nervous edge, so that sudden noises, movements, or unexpected news set one on alert as a matter of temperament.

nodes.label: malleable
nodes.gloss: This means easily shifting one's opinions, plans and loyalties to match whoever is speaking most forcefully, yielding to pressure from others rather than holding a firm position of one's own.

nodes.label: maniacal
nodes.gloss: This means acting with a wild, frenzied intensity, laughing, shouting and lunging as though one has lost all hold on reason and self-control.

nodes.label: morose
nodes.gloss: This means keeping a sullen, dour mood and withdrawing into silence, showing little willingness to talk and answering others, when one answers at all, with grudging short replies.

nodes.label: obscene
nodes.gloss: This means speaking in a crudely lewd manner, using sexually offensive language and innuendo that shocks or disgusts those who hear it.

nodes.label: overmasculine
nodes.gloss: This means acting out macho swagger at every turn, dominating conversations and people, bragging of toughness, treating aggression as strength, and answering any hint of softness with scorn or a show of force.

nodes.label: pathetic
nodes.gloss: This means being consistently feeble and inadequate in one's conduct and character, falling short in ways that earn contempt rather than sympathy from those around one.

nodes.label: phony
nodes.gloss: This means putting on a show of warmth, interest, or expertise one does not actually feel or have, and presenting a false self to others as though it were genuine.

nodes.label: rugged
nodes.gloss: This means facing hardship without complaint, enduring discomfort and setbacks through one's own resilience, and handling problems alone rather than leaning on others for help.

nodes.label: unladylike
nodes.gloss: This means behaving rudely, coarsely and boisterously, with loud talk, crude jokes and rough manners that flout genteel expectations for women and never bother to hide it.
